comments.text: he Mennonite agricultural model in Spanish Lookout is clearly an economic miracle for Belize's food security. However, expanding farmlands means shrinking natural forests. Should Belize sacrifice part of its rainforest to ensure food sovereignty and economic growth, or strictly cap agricultural land expansion even if it slows down production?
